title: Evaluation on an orthonormal n-frame is bounded by the Euclidean coefficient norm: |α(τ)| ≤ |α|_E
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let α be an n-covector on ℝ^P (Covector (Euclid P) n) and let τ = (τ_0, …, τ_{n−1}) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P. Then |α(τ_0, …, τ_{n−1})| ≤ |α|_E = covectorEuclideanNorm α.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → |α τ| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α
